headline: BSE, NSE, and Nuvama Wealth in focus as SEBI revises CAS framework
hook: New compliance costs for exchange infrastructure

The regulatory update changes how financial asset holdings are reported and consolidated for investors. Market intermediaries must adapt their reporting systems to align with the revised guidelines. Indian retail investors should monitor compliance costs and operational workflow changes for these market infrastructure institutions.
why_it_matters: New reporting rules may raise compliance costs for exchanges.
